title: 第4章 落入凡间的小仙女

content_zh:
将玉绯烟放地上，夏侯擎天紧盯着她的眼睛。没有恐惧和退缩，反倒是有一种叫做“欣赏”的东西在她眼里莹莹生辉。
真有趣！
“小野猫，爷刚才差点儿杀了你呢！”
夏侯擎天的大手在玉绯烟细细的脖子上轻抚着，指尖下的皮肤光滑细腻，如上好的琼玉，像极了王公贵族家里娇养着的千金小姐。
她真的是偷跑出来的奴儿么？
夏侯擎天眸子一暗。
颈部一股酥麻的感觉散开，玉绯烟脸颊微红，伸手将他拍开，糥糥地回了句“你才不会”，再次将地上的尸体检查了一遍。
如她所料，之前被箭射中的人，箭头全部没入他们第六节颈椎骨，力道一致，完美至极！
得经历多少生死，要杀多少人，才能将死亡的力道掌控的这么好？
“你是怎么做到的？”玉绯烟现在是彻底佩服眼前的紫衣男子，同时也把他列入第一危险人物。在没有杀这个人的能力时，千万不能和他为敌！
“求爷，爷就教你！”
看着玉绯烟巴巴小眼神里的崇拜，夏侯擎天笑得得意，眼神更是肆无忌惮地将玉绯烟从头打量到脚，手指上还缠绕着一个粉色的物件。
这是……她的肚兜！
玉绯烟第一次意识到眼前这人根本就不是高洁如玉的君子，他顶着一张清贵俊逸的皮，包裹着一颗邪恶无耻的心。
只是，人在屋檐下，不得不低头。
更何况他手里的粉色肚兜实在是太刺眼了！玉绯烟完全相信，如果她断然拒绝，这个恶劣的男人定会使出什么下流招数。
酝酿了一会儿，玉绯烟发出了猫儿一样的声音，“我——”话没说完，夏侯擎天脸色突变，背起玉绯烟一跃而起，黑色的弩箭狠狠地扎在地上。
“嗖嗖嗖——”
只听得风声，夏侯擎天已经躲了百来支弩箭。
“你到底有多少仇家？”玉绯烟左手扒着夏侯擎天，右手抓着一支袭来的弩箭，将他身后的危险全部扫开。

铁制弩箭？不像是寻常仇杀。
这个男人究竟是什么身份？！
“怕了？”这是夏侯擎天第二次问这话。
“切——要怕的是他们！这次恐怕有来无回了！”
玉绯烟的回答逗乐了夏侯擎天。
算了，不管她是什么身份，单是这脾性就对极了他的胃口，这小野猫他要定了！
“射他背上的人！”
似乎发现玉绯烟是夏侯擎天的“弱点”，所有弩箭都对准了她。不过堂堂华夏国上校也不是吃素的，玉绯烟双腿从背后夹紧了夏侯擎天的腰，双手各持一支弩箭，硬是将攻击过来的弩箭击落在地上。
小看女人，可是会吃亏哟！
就在玉绯烟再次打掉一批弩箭时，一支落地的弩箭突然裂开，小巧的箭头从里面射出，以风的速度刺入玉绯烟的左肩。
箭中箭！
距离太近，玉绯烟避之不及，锋利的箭头刺入肌肤，疼得她一阵哆嗦。
当异样的血腥味传来，玉绯烟忍不住皱了眉头。
靠！这箭头有毒！
即便如此，玉绯烟依旧咬牙拽紧了夏侯擎天的衣服，守卫着他的后背。他肯把后背交给她，她自然不能辜负了这种信任！
等夏侯擎天察觉到背后的异常，玉绯烟已经晕厥过去，“猫儿，猫儿？”他忙把她放下，这才发现玉绯烟左肩上的弩箭和黑紫色的血迹。
如果玉绯烟醒着，她一定会发现这个不可一世的男人那双极美的丹凤眼里，弥漫着浓烈的杀气。原本墨色的眸子被杀气染成了魅惑的紫金色，像神秘的深海，波涛汹涌。
“伤了我的人，你们该死——”
一道紫金色的光芒从男人身上迸发出来，凶猛地席卷向躲在暗处的偷袭者。
王者一怒，血染山河！

“你，你是——”看到男子妖冶的紫眸，为首的人惊恐万分，可他根本来不及呼救，就被烧成了灰烬。
“你们太弱了——”
风吹过，青烟袅袅，森林里一片死气，静得可怕，仿佛一切从来没有发生过……
畔山林语，云雾围场的皇家别院。
沉甸甸的气氛压得王太医喘不过气来，他擦了擦头上的汗，战战兢兢地站了起来。
“如何？”
夏侯擎天优雅地坐着，手里把玩着一只紫水晶做的围棋子。
看似漫不经心，可凝重的空气已经出卖了这位爷的心情——非常不好！
“弩箭上的毒出自西越国，下官已经为小姐解了毒。只是……”王太医吞了吞口水，心里有些忐忑不安。

content_en:
Putting Jade Feiyan on the ground, Xiahou Qingtian stared into her eyes. There was no fear or shrinkage, but something called "appreciation" shone brightly in her eyes.
How interesting!
"Little wildcat, I almost killed you just now!"
Xiahou Qingtian's big hands caressed Yu Feiyan's slender neck. The skin under his fingertips was smooth and delicate, like the finest jade, like a pampered young lady raised by a prince and aristocrat.
Is she really a slave who escaped?
Xiahou Qingtian's eyes darkened.
A numb feeling in her neck dissipated. Yu Feiyan's cheeks were slightly red. She reached out and slapped him away. She replied "You don't know how" with a stern voice, and checked the body on the ground again.
As she expected, the arrows of the people who had been hit by arrows all penetrated into their sixth cervical vertebrae with the same force, perfect!
How many lives and deaths do you have to go through and how many people do you have to kill before you can control the power of death so well?
"How did you do it?" Yu Feiyan now completely admires the man in purple in front of her, and also lists him as the most dangerous person. When you don't have the ability to kill this person, you must not become his enemy!
"Please, I will teach you!"
Seeing the admiration in Yu Feiyan's little eyes, Xiahou Qingtian smiled proudly, and his eyes unscrupulously looked at Yu Feiyan from head to toe, with a pink object wrapped around his fingers.
This is...her bellyband!
For the first time, Yu Feiyan realized that the man in front of her was not a noble and pure gentleman at all. He wore a noble and handsome skin, but wrapped an evil and shameless heart.
However, people under the eaves have to bow their heads.
What's more, the pink bellyband in his hand is really eye-catching! Yu Feiyan fully believed that if she refused flatly, this nasty man would definitely use some nasty tricks.
After brewing for a while, Yu Feiyan made a cat-like sound, "I -" Before he could finish his words, Xiahou Qingtian's expression suddenly changed, he carried Yu Feiyan on his back and jumped up, the black crossbow arrow piercing the ground hard.
"Swish swish——"
Just hearing the sound of the wind, Xiahou Qingtian had already dodged hundreds of crossbow arrows.
"How many enemies do you have?" Yu Feiyan held Xiahou Qingtian with her left hand, and grabbed an incoming crossbow arrow with her right hand, sweeping away all dangers behind him.
Iron crossbow? It's not like an ordinary vendetta.
What is this man's identity? !
"Are you scared?" This was the second time Xiahou Qingtian asked this question.
"Tch—it's them we have to be afraid of! I'm afraid there will be no return this time!"
Yu Feiyan's answer amused Xiahou Qingtian.
Forget it, no matter what her status is, her temperament alone is to his liking. He is going to be sure of this little wild cat!
"Shoot the guy on his back!"
It seemed that Yu Feiyan was found to be Xiahou Qingtian's "weakness", and all the crossbows were aimed at her. However, the dignified Huaxia Colonel was not a vegetarian. Yu Feiyan clamped Xiahou Qingtian's waist with her legs from behind, holding a crossbow in each hand, and shot down the attacking crossbow to the ground.
If you look down on women, you will suffer a loss!
Just when Yu Feiyan knocked down a batch of crossbow arrows again, a crossbow arrow that fell to the ground suddenly cracked, and a small arrow shot out from the inside, piercing Yu Feiyan's left shoulder at the speed of the wind.
Arrow hits the target!
The distance was too close, and Yu Feiyan couldn't avoid it. The sharp arrow pierced her skin, causing her to tremble in pain.
When the strange smell of blood came, Yu Feiyan couldn't help but frown.
Depend on! This arrow is poisonous!
Even so, Yu Feiyan still gritted her teeth and tightened her grip on Xiahou Qingtian's clothes, guarding his back. He was willing to give his back to her, so naturally she couldn't live up to this trust!
By the time Xiahou Qingtian noticed the abnormality behind him, Yu Feiyan had already fainted, "Cat, cat?" He hurriedly put her down, and then he discovered the crossbow arrow and black and purple blood on Yu Feiyan's left shoulder.
If Yu Feiyan was awake, she would definitely find that the extremely beautiful red phoenix eyes of this arrogant man were filled with strong murderous intent.The original black eyes were dyed with murderous aura into a charming purple-gold color, like the mysterious deep sea with turbulent waves.
"Those who hurt me, you deserve to die——"
A purple-gold light burst out from the man's body, fiercely sweeping toward the sneak attacker hiding in the darkness.
When the king is angry, the mountains and rivers are stained with blood!
"You, you are -" Seeing the man's charming purple eyes, the leader was horrified, but before he could call for help, he was burned to ashes.
"You are too weak——"
The wind blew, the smoke curled up, and the forest was filled with death and eerie silence, as if nothing had ever happened...
The language of the mountains and forests, the Royal Courtyard in the cloudy paddock.
The heavy atmosphere made Dr. Wang breathless. He wiped the sweat from his head and stood up tremblingly.
"How?"
Xiahou Qingtian sat elegantly, playing with a Go piece made of amethyst in his hand.
It seems careless, but the solemn air has betrayed this man's mood - very bad!
"The poison on the crossbow arrows came from the West Yue Kingdom, and the lower official has detoxified the poison for the young lady. It's just..." Doctor Wang swallowed, feeling a little uneasy.
